title: John Wayne curfew
body: John Wayne Airport (SNA, Santa Ana) operates under a noise ordinance / curfew roughly 22:00-07:00 local with commercial departure limits. Airside/policy is the binding constraint; terminal expansion does not create night slots. Do not confuse SNA with SAT.

title: SFO airside and slots
body: San Francisco International is frequently GDP-constrained (marine layer) and is Level-2 schedule facilitated. Unmet passenger demand is max(0, implied-served); much of the gap is airside/policy plus leakage to OAK/SJC, not a missing concourse.

title: ANC long-haul convention
body: Anchorage long-haul share uses T-100 segments with a Eurocontrol default of >4000 km. ANC-JFK is about 5420 km / 3370 mi. Also report international share and optional pct_over_6h. Cargo is out unless asked. T-100 is segment traffic, not true O&D.

title: New England peer set
body: New England commercial set used for TEOI peers: BOS, BDL, PVD, PWM, MHT, BTV, BGR, ORH. PWM is Portland Maine, not PDX. BOS is scale; regionals can win as landside-constrained on a peer-relative rank.

title: LA vs Santa Ana
body: LA resolves to LAX, not the metro. Santa Ana resolves to SNA, not SAT. Congestion compare is delay + utilization + constraint type; no fake single congestion score.
